text:
taylor.p: Quick sync — need to lock pricing changes for next quarter: trial -> paid conversion path, dev vs prod rate-limit differentiation, and overage grace windows. Putting rough tradeoffs here.

kai.g: +1. Are we leaning toward soft caps (throttling + notifications) or hard caps (blocking) for trials? Customers want frictionless dev experience.

sana.f: Revenue lens: soft caps increase usage & conversion but raise abuse risk. If we do 7-day grace for first overage, conservatively model +8% conversion, -2% short-term revenue churn.

lee_s: Sales: enterprise customers asked for explicit burst allowances during onboarding. They hate surprise blocks. Would prefer per-customer burst buckets tied to committed usage.

kai.g: Proposal A (dev-friendly):
```
- Free trial: 100k tokens/day soft cap -> notify at 80%, throttle to 5rps beyond
- Starter: 500k tokens/day hard cap + overage invoice
- Pro/Enterprise: dedicated quotas + configurable burst pool
```
Rollout: feature-flagged, metric monitoring, 2-week beta with 10 pilot accounts.

kai.g: Proposal B (conservative): enforce hard caps on trial, credit card required for overages, less abuse but lower trial usage.

rebecca.l: Legal/compliance: overage billing terms need clear consent. For EU customers, display upfront T&Cs in checkout. Also log user acceptance for audits.

sana.f: Billing impact for Proposal A: need new SKU for "burst credits" and tracking. Forecasting tool needs update to show expected overage revenue. Ops cost estimate ~ $5k/mo initially for tracking infra.

taylor.p: Launch criteria (what I want to see before we flip):
- Beta with 10 customers (mixed org sizes)
- No critical bugs in quota accounting for 48h
- Clear UX for notifications + one-click top-up
- Legal signoff on billing copy
- Finance approves SKUs & forecasting

lee_s: Can we include a grandfathering rule for existing Starter customers so they don't get auto-limited? Sales will push back otherwise.

kai.g: Yes — config flag: `legacy_quota_mode: true` per-customer to keep current behavior. We'll default new signups to new model.

billing-bot: usage-report: pilot cohort ran avg 1.8x the expected burst usage; spike window 09:02-09:08 UTC on 2025-11-04. No billing anomalies detected.

sana.f: One open question: how long is the overage invoice window? Net 30? auto-bill card? That affects churn.

rebecca.l: For card-on-file customers we can auto-bill with explicit consent. For invoiced customers, keep Net30 and a grace period before service pause.

taylor.p: OK next steps:
- kai: build feature-flagged soft-cap implementation + burst pool prototype (ETA 2 wks)
- sana: wire up SKU + forecast model change (ETA 1 wk)
- rebecca: draft billing consent copy & EU text (ETA 3 days)
- lee: nominate 10 pilot customers

kai.g: I'll add telemetry events: `quota.warn`, `quota.throttle`, `burst.consume`.

taylor.p: Meeting in 48h to review pilot candidates and flag status. If anyone adds blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:
